name: software-classification
title_zh: 医疗器械软件按 MDR 定几类，逐条讲清依据
tagline_zh: App 到底算 IIa 还是 IIb，别靠销售拍脑袋。它按 Annex VIII 的 3.3 实施规则和 Rule…
tagline_en: Stop guessing if your app is IIa or IIb. It walks Annex VIII rule 3.3 and Rule 11 step by step, and writes down.
desc_en: Classify medical device software (SaMD) under MDR Annex VIII — implementing rule 3.3 and Rule 11 — and say which class it falls in and why. Use when the user asks "what class is our software", "is this Rule 11", "SaMD classification", "is our app class IIa or IIb", "MDR class for software", or describes software whose MDR class is in question.
why_zh: 先判是不是 SaMD，再走 3.3 的实施规则，最后用 Rule 11 定档。结论后面挂着推理链。
why_en: First SaMD or not, then the 3.3 implementing rule, then Rule 11 for the class. Every verdict carries its reasoning chain, not.
limit_zh: 只管 MDR 附录 VIII 的软件定类，不碰 FDA、不碰 AI 法案、不写技术文档、不代做临床评价。
limit_en: Only MDR Annex VIII software classification — no FDA, no AI Act, no tech docs, no clinical evaluation. You must supply intended purpose, indications.
title_en: MDR software class, decided rule by rule
